sources.facts: Red-brick L-shaped Gothic block, bay and main gable facing west on north end. Steep iron roof, truncated hip south, 4 east, 2 west and 1 north dormer. West verandah two levels, five arches, paired iron columns. Original brick kitchen behind the north side.
Owner identifies the former Sisters of Mercy school, completed in 1888–89. Current front door is on Helen Street. Endeavour Gallery was added at the rear in 2001.
National Trust reports repairs to stairs, columns and deck in 2025. Consulted written facts only.
